WITH race_name_averages AS (
  SELECT r.name AS race_name, AVG(cs.points) AS average_points
  FROM constructorStandings AS cs
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId
  GROUP BY r.name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_points) AS value
  FROM race_name_averages
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT a.race_name, a.average_points, a.average_points - o.value AS difference_from_overall
  FROM race_name_averages AS a
  JOIN overall_average AS o ON o.value IS NOT NULL
  WHERE a.average_points > o.value
),
final_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_points) AS value
  FROM kept_groups
)
SELECT k.race_name,
       k.average_points,
       k.difference_from_overall,
       k.average_points - f.value AS difference_from_final_average
FROM kept_groups AS k
JOIN final_average AS f ON f.value IS NOT NULL
